verdict.rationale: Power efficiency is a fair question for a discrete GPU, so the axis applies, but the pack documents no power envelope (TGP/TDP, PSU requirement) and contains no independent performance-per-watt testing. The only efficiency mention is a vague marketing line about 'studio-class power and efficiency'. The TechPowerUp review discusses cooler noise and temperatures, which are adjacent thermal results rather than power-draw or perf-per-watt data, so neither earns credit.
